instruction: A grand concert harp styled in art-deco geometry, its gilded column stepped with fluted chevrons and a fan-motif crown at the neck. Polished black lacquer meets brushed gold trim along the soundboard, and the taut vertical strings form a crisp symmetrical sweep.
